newsitem.title: USA: Kmart February same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kmart February same store sales up.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday its same-store sales, on a consolidated basis, were up 3.9 percent in the four-week period ended February 26.
Same-store sales for U.S. Kmart units only were up 4.1 percent.
Total consolidated sales for February rose 2.3 percent to $2.07 billion from $2.03 billion a year ago.

Kmart's consolidated results include a 0.5 percent drop in same-store sales for international operations and a 28.4 percent decline in total sales to $55.0 million from $77.0 million for international stores.
Kmart said February results excluded its Builders Square operations, which were classified as a discontinued operation at the end of fiscal 1996.
Kmart has 2,134 Kmart retail outlets in the United States and operates 127 stores internationally.
